report.summary: Patient P-D009 (73 y/o F, Medicare Advantage, home tract 17031720500 in Cook County) was seen today for visit V-D009. The most recent social-needs screener (2026-10-19) was negative for food insecurity (food_worry and food_ran_out both "never_true"), and the tract is not flagged as USDA low-income/low-access (low_income 0.0, LILA 0.0; tract-level food-insecurity prevalence 7.6%). Eligibility was verified from page descriptions where available; no enrollment or cost barriers identified for these three.
